title: Paying Off Credit Card Balance from Checking Account (Internal)
summary: This internal procedure explains how to pay off a customer’s credit card balance using funds from their Rho-Bank checking account via the pay_credit_card_from_checking_9182 tool, including prerequisites, identity/balance checks, and required tool arguments. It states amount must be positive and cannot exceed either the checking balance or credit card outstanding balance, and confirms with new balances.
faqs: What are the prerequisites to pay a credit card balance from a Rho-Bank checking account?

What amount rules apply for pay_credit_card_from_checking_9182 (positive, and limits vs balances)?
Which steps should I follow to process the transfer end-to-end (including authorization)?
